name: dsh-feishu
description: Talk to DeepSeek Harness from Feishu (飞书): each Feishu chat is bound to a series of DSH sessions, messages become turns, answers are pushed back, an interactive `/permission` card switches the session's file sandbox mode, a `feishu_ask` card asks the user a question with buttons plus a free-text note field (instead of the GUI dialog a Feishu user cannot see), `/model` sends a card whose buttons switch the session model, `/sessions` sends a card whose buttons switch back to an earlier conversation of the same chat (`/open <n>` still works), and `/new` / `/open` manage the chat's conversation generations. Permission requests are asked with a Feishu card too (/approval toggles the policy). Every outgoing message is a card, because Feishu plain text does not render Markdown. Inbound files and images are downloaded into the workspace. Zero runtime dependencies — hand-rolled protobuf framing over Node's built-in WebSocket. 在飞书里直接跟 DSH 对话。
author: wangbodbs
